summary: Fix embedder guard and audit handoff
pull_request_body: Fix the embedder to raise EmbeddingsError instead of ZeroDivisionError when ai.provider is ollama and no Ollama URL is set. Add a guard in _embed_ollama that checks the URL list before computing batches. Replace the hardening audit intake handoff with gh issue create so the finding files on a runner with only GH_TOKEN and no model credential. This unblocks the five lost findings from runs 40726982400 through 40758364472.
why: #2524: devops roadmap intake stops with ZeroDivisionError when ai.provider is ollama and ai.ollama_urls is empty. The hardening audit workflow hits this crash on every failed run and loses its findings. After the crash is fixed, the workflow still cannot file findings because the runner has no model credential.
what_changes: Add a guard in _embed_ollama that raises EmbeddingsError with the embedding_no_provider message when the Ollama URL list is empty.
Replace the hardening audit intake handoff with gh issue create so it works on a runner with only GH_TOKEN and no model credential.
feasibility: The embedder code at src/devops_cli/ai/rag/embeddings.py shows _embed_ollama calls _get_ollama_urls() and then uses len(urls) in a modulo at line 988. When urls is empty, this causes ZeroDivisionError. The _dispatch_embed method routes provider == ollama to _embed_ollama without checking the URL list, so the EmbeddingsError at the bottom of _dispatch_embed is never reached.

The workflow at .github/workflows/defect-pr-hardening-audit.yml shows the handoff step runs uv run devops roadmap intake. The workflow declares issues: write permission and sets GH_TOKEN. The gh CLI is available on GitHub-hosted runners.

First checks: uv run devops ci test tests/ai/rag/test_embeddings.py to verify the guard raises EmbeddingsError. uv run devops ci test tests/workflows/test_defect_pr_hardening_audit.py to verify the workflow step uses gh issue create.
existing_tool: No external tool covers this need. The fix is a guard clause in the project's own embedder and a workflow step change. Written cost: about 5 lines of guard code in _embed_ollama, about 3 lines of workflow YAML, and about 15 lines of test. Total about 25 lines to build, keep and fix. No internal code is deleted.

decisions.decision: Place the guard in _embed_ollama after _get_ollama_urls returns, before any batch computation.
decisions.reason: The function that consumes the URL list validates it at entry. This is the standard guard-at-entry pattern and keeps the check next to the code that would crash.

decisions.decision: Replace devops roadmap intake with gh issue create in the workflow.
decisions.reason: The workflow already has issues: write permission and GH_TOKEN. No model credential is needed. The finding is specific to a PR number, so duplicate risk is low.

decisions.decision: Use ERRORS.rag.embedding_no_provider for the guard's error message.
decisions.reason: This is the same message the existing EmbeddingsError at the bottom of _dispatch_embed uses. It names the model and provider, which is what a caller needs to act on.

rejected.evidence: _dispatch_embed already has the no-provider EmbeddingsError at its bottom. Adding a URL check there duplicates the check that _embed_ollama must own, and _embed_ollama is the function that uses the URL list.

rejected.alternative: Add a --no-embed flag to devops roadmap intake.
rejected.evidence: It adds a new CLI surface for a one-off workflow need. The workflow already has the GitHub API access it needs via gh issue create.

rejected.alternative: Scope the handoff step to run only when a model credential is present.
rejected.evidence: The finding is lost on every runner without a model. The issue body says the finding must be filed, not skipped.

added.name: Embedder raises EmbeddingsError for empty Ollama URL list
added.text: When ai.provider is ollama and no Ollama URL is configured, the embedder SHALL raise EmbeddingsError with the embedding_no_provider message and no traceback.

scenarios.name: Empty URL list with ollama provider
scenarios.when: ai.provider is ollama and ai.ollama_urls is empty and embed_texts is called with one text
scenarios.then: EmbeddingsError is raised with the embedding_no_provider message and no ZeroDivisionError traceback appears

added.name: Hardening audit files finding without a model credential
added.text: The hardening audit workflow SHALL file its finding as a GitHub issue using a path that requires no model or embedding credential.

scenarios.name: Workflow step runs on a runner with only GH_TOKEN
scenarios.when: the hardening report step fails and the runner has no model credential
scenarios.then: a GitHub issue is created with the finding title and body and the workflow step exits with code 0

groups.title: Add EmbeddingsError guard for empty Ollama URL list
groups.test: Write a test that constructs EmbeddingsEngine with ai.provider set to ollama and ai.ollama_urls set to an empty list. Call embed_texts with one text. Assert that EmbeddingsError is raised and its message contains the embedding_no_provider text. Assert that ZeroDivisionError is not raised
groups.implementation: In _embed_ollama, after urls = self._get_ollama_urls(), add a guard: if urls is empty, raise EmbeddingsError with ERRORS.rag.embedding_no_provider formatted with self.model and self.ai_config.provider, and details with model and provider. This guard sits before any batch computation
groups.verify: uv run devops ci test tests/ai/rag/test_embeddings.py

groups.title: Replace intake handoff with gh issue create
groups.test: Write a test that reads the workflow YAML file. Parse the handoff step. Assert that the step's run block contains gh issue create. Assert that the step's run block does not contain devops roadmap intake
groups.implementation: In the handoff step of .github/workflows/defect-pr-hardening-audit.yml, replace the uv run devops roadmap intake command with gh issue create. Pass the title, the body file, and a label for priority. Keep the existing INTAKE_BODY heredoc and the sed substitution. Remove the uv run prefix since gh is a runner binary
